rejected_rule.statement: When there is an acknowledgment of the debt, prescription commences to run from the date of acknowledgment of the debt.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: In view of the facts and circumstances pertaining to the instant appeal, I re-iterate that P5 is an acknowledgement of the debt by the Defendant-Respondent and when there is an acknowledgment of the debt, prescription commences to run from the date of acknowledgment of the debt.
